title: Tough dual-network Janus hydrogel patch for universal and reversible adhesion
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,33456-33465
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04058B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Xiuli Pu, Buyun Chen, Qiang Li, Chen Chen, Xinling Wang
In this work, a P(AAsp-AGlu)/PAADA Janus hydrogel patch is reported with excellent mechanical strength (around 410 kPa), prominent adhesion properties (over 550 J m−2) and repeatable adhesion (less than 20% decreasing after 5 adhesion cycles).
